title.source: 羽絨衣一點熱都不會產生，為什麼穿上就暖？｜原來如此事務所
title.text: A down jacket makes no heat at all. So why does it keep you warm? | So That's Why

description.source:
寒流來的早上從衣櫃拿出羽絨衣，摸起來是冰的。它沒插電、沒有電池，自己一點熱都不會產生，為什麼穿上就暖？

這一集，所長和小問跟著同一件羽絨衣找那個暖爐：熱從哪裡來、為什麼一直往外跑、同一個公園裡的鐵欄杆為什麼摸起來比木椅冰、什麼最會擋熱、羽絨壓扁淋濕或被風吹透為什麼就不暖，最後用保溫瓶和一顆包起來的冰塊，看保暖到底是在做什麼。

本集插圖由 AI 生成。功率與倍數都是教科書的典型值或大約的數量級；每個說法的出處列在下方參考資料。

資料截至 2026-11-04
description.text:
On a cold-snap morning you take your down jacket out of the closet, and it feels cold. It has no plug and no battery, and it makes no heat of its own. So why does it keep you warm once you put it on?

In this episode, the Chief and Little Q follow one down jacket to find the heater: where the heat comes from, why it keeps running away, why the iron railing in a park feels colder than the wooden bench in the same park, what blocks heat best, and why down stops keeping you warm when it's squashed, soaked or blown through by wind. At the end, a vacuum flask and a wrapped-up ice cube show what keeping warm really does.

The illustrations in this episode were made with AI. The power figures and multiples are typical textbook values or rough orders of magnitude; the source of every claim is listed in the references below.

lines.source: 所長！寒流來了，我打開衣櫃，
lines.text: Chief! So cold! I open my closet,

lines.source: 羽絨衣是冰的耶！
lines.text: and my down jacket is cold!

lines.source: 它不是很暖嗎？怎麼冰冰的？
lines.text: Isn't it supposed to be warm? Why's it cold?

lines.source: 先別急。你摸摸自己的手，是暖的吧？
lines.text: Easy now. Feel your own hand. It's warm, right?

lines.source: 暖的。可是它又沒插電，
lines.text: Warm. But it's not plugged in,

lines.source: 穿上一下下，怎麼就暖了？
lines.text: so why's it warm once I wear it?

lines.source: 那熱是從哪裡來的？
lines.text: Where does the heat come from?

lines.source: 這個嘛，答案可能比你想的還要近。
lines.text: Hmm, the answer's closer than you think.

lines.source: 先猜一件事：用羽絨衣包住一顆冰塊，
lines.text: Guess: wrap ice in a down jacket.

lines.source: 冰會融得比較快，還是比較慢？
lines.text: Will it melt faster, or slower?

lines.source: 還有，公園的鐵欄杆，為什麼摸起來比木椅冰那麼多？
lines.text: Why does the park's iron railing feel so much colder than the wooden bench?

lines.source: 淋濕的羽絨衣，又為什麼一下就不暖了？
lines.text: And why does a wet down jacket stop being warm so fast?

lines.source: 冰冰的衣服，為什麼穿上就暖？
lines.text: A cold jacket... why's it warm on me?

lines.source: 你可以試試看：把溫度計塞進羽絨衣裡，放一個晚上。
lines.text: Try this: put a thermometer in a down jacket overnight.

lines.source: 隔天早上，它量到的跟房間差不多。
lines.text: By morning: about room temp.

lines.source: 它沒有比較暖？
lines.text: It's not warmer?

lines.source: 所以它跟房間裡的椅子一樣冰？
lines.text: So it's as cold as the chair in the room?

lines.source: 對。椅子、桌子、這件羽絨衣，放久了都跟房間一樣。
lines.text: Yes. Chairs, tables, this jacket: given time, they match the room.

lines.source: 房間比你的手冷，摸起來就冰冰的。
lines.text: Colder than your hand, so they feel cold.

lines.source: 裡面一定藏了會熱的東西！
lines.text: Something warm must be inside!

lines.source: 你這樣猜很合理，穿起來真的很像它在發熱。
lines.text: Fair guess. It really feels like it makes heat.

lines.source: 可是打開來看，裡面只有羽絨和布。
lines.text: But open it up: just down and fabric inside.

lines.source: 它要是個會發熱的小暖爐，溫度計早就量到了。
lines.text: If it made heat, the thermometer would've shown it.

lines.source: 那暖爐到底在哪裡？
lines.text: So where IS the heater?

lines.source: 在你身上。
lines.text: You.

lines.source: 你自己，就是那個暖爐。
lines.text: You're the heater yourself.

lines.source: 我？我又沒有在燒火。
lines.text: Me? I'm not burning a fire.

lines.source: 你吃下去的東西，身體會拿來用。
lines.text: Your body uses what you eat.

lines.source: 吃飯就是在加柴火？
lines.text: So eating is like adding firewood?

lines.source: 可以這樣想。
lines.text: Sort of, yes.

lines.source: 用掉的能量，最後大部分都變成了熱。
lines.text: Most of the energy it uses ends up as heat.

lines.source: 一個大人安靜坐著，大約一直放出一百瓦左右的熱，
lines.text: An adult sitting quietly gives off about 100 watts of heat,

lines.source: 跟一顆老式燈泡差不多。
lines.text: like an old-style light bulb.

lines.source: 那我也是一顆燈泡？
lines.text: So I'm a light bulb too?

lines.source: 小朋友的身體比較小，放出的熱少一些，
lines.text: Kids are smaller and give off less,

lines.source: 可是也一直在放；睡著的時候，也只是放得少一點。
lines.text: but you never stop. Even asleep, you just give off a bit less.

lines.source: 那我冷到發抖的時候呢？
lines.text: What about when I'm shivering with cold?

lines.source: 那是身體在把火力開大。
lines.text: Your body's turning it up.

lines.source: 發抖的時候，放出的熱可以是安靜坐著的好幾倍。
lines.text: Shivering can make several times the heat of sitting still.

lines.source: 所以下次你冷到發抖，可以跟自己說：
lines.text: Next time you shiver, tell yourself:

lines.source: 我的暖爐，正在加班。
lines.text: My heater's working overtime.

lines.source: 可是我一直在放熱，
lines.text: But I make heat all day,

lines.source: 為什麼還是會冷？
lines.text: so why do I still get cold?

lines.source: 因為熱有一個脾氣：
lines.text: Heat's rule:

lines.source: 它一定從熱的地方，往冷的地方跑。
lines.text: it always flows from hot to cold.

lines.source: 你雙手捧著熱可可，熱就從杯子跑進你的手。
lines.text: Hold hot cocoa: heat flows from the cup into your hands.

lines.source: 你手上拿一顆冰塊，手會變冰，冰會慢慢融。
lines.text: Hold ice: your hand gets cold and the ice melts.

lines.source: 是冰把冷傳給我？
lines.text: So the ice gives me its cold?

lines.source: 其實是倒過來：你手上的熱，跑進冰塊裡。
lines.text: The other way: your hand's heat goes into the ice.

lines.source: 冷不會跑，一直在跑的是熱。
lines.text: Cold doesn't move. Heat is what moves.

lines.source: 熱不會倒過來跑嗎？
lines.text: Can't heat flow backward?

lines.source: 自己不會。你的手，從來不會被冰塊弄得更暖。
lines.text: Not on its own. Ice never makes your hand warmer.

lines.source: 冬天光腳踩在磁磚上，熱就從你的腳跑進地板。
lines.text: On cold tiles barefoot, heat leaves your feet for the floor.

lines.source: 可是踩地毯就還好，
lines.text: But rugs feel okay,

lines.source: 為什麼磁磚比較冰？
lines.text: so why are tiles colder?

lines.source: 先記住這個問題，等一下公園會告訴你。
lines.text: Hold that thought. The park will tell.

lines.source: 所以冷，就是熱一直跑掉？
lines.text: So cold is just heat always running away?

lines.source: 對。衣服擋不住它跑，只能讓它跑慢一點。
lines.text: Right. Clothes can't stop it, only slow it.

lines.source: 走到公園，鐵欄杆好冰！
lines.text: The iron railing's freezing!

lines.source: 木頭椅子還好耶。
lines.text: The wooden bench is fine.

lines.source: 鐵本來就比較冷吧？
lines.text: Iron's just colder, right?

lines.source: 聽起來很對。可是它們整晚都待在同一個公園，
lines.text: Sounds right. But they spent all night in the same park,

lines.source: 其實差不多一樣冷。
lines.text: so they're about equally cold.

lines.source: 怎麼可能？摸起來差好多。
lines.text: No way! They feel so different.

lines.source: 因為你的手不是溫度計。
lines.text: Hands fool you.

lines.source: 手感覺到的，是熱從手上跑走得多快。
lines.text: Your hand feels how fast heat leaves it.

lines.source: 鐵把你手上的熱搬走得很快，木頭搬得很慢。
lines.text: Iron carries heat off your hand fast; wood carries it slowly.

lines.source: 鋼鐵傳熱的本事，比木頭快上百倍。
lines.text: Steel's over 100 times faster than wood.

lines.source: 地毯和磁磚也是這樣：磁磚把你腳上的熱，搬得比較快。
lines.text: Rugs and tiles are the same: tiles carry heat from your feet faster.

lines.source: 羽絨衣的拉鍊頭，也比布冰！
lines.text: The zipper's colder than cloth, too!

lines.source: 可是你捏著它一下下，它就不冰了：你的熱已經跑進去了。
lines.text: But hold it a moment and it isn't cold: your heat has gone in.

lines.source: 所以下次你摸到冰冰的東西，可以想一想：
lines.text: Next time something feels cold, ask:

lines.source: 是它真的比較冷，還是它很會把熱搬走？
lines.text: is it really colder, or just great at carrying heat away?

lines.source: 那什麼最會擋熱？
lines.text: So what blocks heat best?

lines.source: 答案可能會讓你意外：身邊最會擋熱的，是空氣。
lines.text: This may surprise you: the best heat blocker around you is air.

lines.source: 空氣？我們每天泡在空氣裡耶。
lines.text: Air? We're soaking in air every day!

lines.source: 不會動的空氣，非常不會傳熱。
lines.text: Still air barely carries heat.

lines.source: 麻煩的是，空氣很難乖乖不動。
lines.text: The trouble is, air hates staying still.

lines.source: 它為什麼會動？
lines.text: Why does it move?

lines.source: 貼著你的空氣被你弄暖了，就會往上飄走，
lines.text: Air next to you gets warm and floats up,

lines.source: 換一批冷空氣過來，熱就被一路帶走。
lines.text: cold air moves in, and heat gets carried off.

lines.source: 暖的空氣，為什麼會往上飄？
lines.text: Why does warm air float up?

lines.source: 暖空氣比旁邊的冷空氣輕，就會浮上去。
lines.text: It's lighter than cold air, so it rises.

lines.source: 所以你就算站著不動，熱也一直被帶走。
lines.text: Even standing still, heat keeps leaving you.

lines.source: 那羽絨衣暖，是因為羽毛很暖？
lines.text: So the jacket's warm because feathers are warm?

lines.source: 一團羽絨傳熱的本事，其實跟空氣差不多。
lines.text: Down actually carries heat about as well as air.

lines.source: 你用放大鏡看一朵羽絨，
lines.text: Magnify a puff of down:

lines.source: 它像一團很細很細的小絲，往四面八方張開。
lines.text: it's a tangle of super-fine threads, spreading out every way.

lines.source: 一大把擠在一起，就撐出好多好多小空間。
lines.text: Packed together, they prop open tons of tiny spaces.

lines.source: 空氣被關在這些小空間裡，想飄也飄不走。
lines.text: Air gets trapped in them and can't float away.

lines.source: 那穿一件空氣不就好了？
lines.text: So why not just wear air?

lines.source: 一大片空氣會自己轉圈，把熱帶走。
lines.text: Open air swirls around and takes heat off.

lines.source: 切成很多很小的格子，它才轉不起來。
lines.text: Cut it into tiny cells, and it can't swirl.

lines.source: 像好多好多小房間！
lines.text: Lots of tiny rooms!

lines.source: 羽絨衣是一件裝滿空氣的衣服！
lines.text: A down jacket is a coat full of air!

lines.source: 我覺得這是它最聰明的地方：
lines.text: Here's the clever part:

lines.source: 最重要的材料，是不用錢的空氣。
lines.text: the key material is air, and air is free.

lines.source: 你的毛衣、棉被，也都在用同一招：把空氣關起來。
lines.text: Your sweater and your quilt use the same trick: trap air.

lines.source: 那貓咪的毛也是？
lines.text: And a cat's fur too?

lines.source: 對，動物的毛，也是把空氣關在毛裡面。
lines.text: Yes. Animal fur traps air in it too.

lines.source: 那我把羽絨衣壓扁呢？
lines.text: What if I squash my jacket?

lines.source: 你用力抱住它，抱過的地方就扁了一塊。
lines.text: Hug it hard, and the spot you hug goes flat.

lines.source: 扁掉的地方，關住的空氣變少，
lines.text: Flat spots trap less air,

lines.source: 那裡就沒那麼暖。
lines.text: so less warmth.

lines.source: 那我坐在它上面呢？
lines.text: What if I sit on it?

lines.source: 那屁股底下那一塊，就被你壓得最扁。
lines.text: Then the bit under your bottom is flattest.

lines.source: 那越重越厚，就一定越暖？
lines.text: So heavier and thicker always means warmer?

lines.source: 重不重，不是重點。
lines.text: Weight isn't it.

lines.source: 重點是裡面，關住了多少不會動的空氣。
lines.text: It's how much still air is trapped inside.

lines.source: 那下雨淋濕了呢？
lines.text: And if it gets rained on?

lines.source: 濕了，水就跑進那些小空間，
lines.text: Water fills those tiny spaces

lines.source: 把空氣擠出去。
lines.text: and pushes the air out.

lines.source: 水傳熱的本事，大約是空氣的二十幾倍。
lines.text: Water carries heat 20-some times better than air.

lines.source: 所以衣服一濕，熱就跑得快很多，穿起來就沒那麼暖。
lines.text: Wet clothes let heat out much faster, so they're less warm.

lines.source: 羽絨濕了還會塌下去，撐不起那些小空間。
lines.text: Wet down collapses; the spaces close.

lines.source: 你淋過冬天的雨，應該記得那種冷。
lines.text: Winter rain: you know that cold.

lines.source: 頭髮沒吹乾，也好冷！
lines.text: Wet hair's freezing too!

lines.source: 對，水在乾掉的時候，還會從你身上再帶走熱。
lines.text: Yes. And as water dries, it takes even more heat from you.

lines.source: 有風的時候，怎麼特別冷？
lines.text: Why is it so cold when it's windy?

lines.source: 還記得那層會往上飄的暖空氣嗎？
lines.text: Remember that rising warm air?

lines.source: 風一來，它還沒飄走就被吹散，
lines.text: Wind blows it away first,

lines.source: 冷空氣換得更勤，熱就跑得更快。
lines.text: cold air swaps in, heat leaves faster.

lines.source: 被風帶走的熱，常常比慢慢碰過去的快得多。
lines.text: Wind often takes heat far faster than slow contact.

lines.source: 這就叫做風寒：同樣的溫度，有風就覺得冷很多。
lines.text: That's wind chill: same temperature, much colder with wind.

lines.source: 風寒說的，是露在外面的皮膚：臉、耳朵、手。
lines.text: Wind chill is about bare skin: your face, ears, and hands.

lines.source: 難怪我耳朵最先痛！
lines.text: No wonder my ears hurt first!

lines.source: 所以羽絨衣外面那層布，最好能擋風，
lines.text: So the jacket's outer layer should block wind,

lines.source: 也最好別讓雨滲進去。
lines.text: and keep rain out, too.

lines.source: 像一面擋風的牆！
lines.text: Like a wind wall!

lines.source: 那拉鍊沒拉好呢？
lines.text: What if it's unzipped?

lines.source: 風就從前面灌進去，把貼著你的暖空氣吹走。
lines.text: Wind pours in and blows your warm air away.

lines.source: 你應該被這樣冷過一次。
lines.text: You've felt that before.

lines.source: 對了，保溫瓶也沒插電，
lines.text: Oh! Flasks have no plug,

lines.source: 為什麼冰水也能保冰？
lines.text: so how does ice water stay cold?

lines.source: 因為保溫瓶跟羽絨衣，做的是同一件事。
lines.text: A flask and a down jacket do the same job.

lines.source: 它不加熱，也不製冷，只是讓熱很難進出。
lines.text: It doesn't heat or cool; heat just can't easily get through.

lines.source: 保溫瓶是兩層瓶子，中間的空氣幾乎都抽掉了。
lines.text: A flask is two bottles, with the air between nearly all gone.

lines.source: 羽絨衣是把空氣關起來，
lines.text: The jacket locks air in,

lines.source: 它是連空氣都不要？
lines.text: and it doesn't want any?

lines.source: 對。羽絨衣裡的空氣動不了，熱還能慢慢碰過去；
lines.text: Right. Jacket air can't move, but heat still creeps by;

lines.source: 保溫瓶中間幾乎什麼都沒有，熱連碰都很難。
lines.text: the flask is nearly empty there; heat barely crosses.

lines.source: 那保溫瓶是更厲害的羽絨衣？
lines.text: So a flask is a super down jacket?

lines.source: 可以這樣想，只是它穿不上身。
lines.text: Sort of, except you can't wear it.

lines.source: 瓶口那裡，像我沒拉的拉鍊？
lines.text: Is the neck like my open zipper?

lines.source: 很像。瓶口沒有真空，熱很多是從那裡溜走。
lines.text: Pretty much. No vacuum at the neck, so much heat slips out there.

lines.source: 所以熱湯保熱，冰水也保冰！
lines.text: So it keeps hot soup hot and ice water cold!

lines.source: 對。還記得熱的脾氣嗎？它往哪邊跑，瓶子就擋哪邊。
lines.text: Yes. Remember heat's rule? Whichever way it runs, the flask blocks it.

lines.source: 那夏天穿羽絨衣呢？
lines.text: And a down jacket in summer?

lines.source: 它一樣把你的熱留住。
lines.text: Keeps heat in.

lines.source: 只是夏天你不想留，就熱得受不了。
lines.text: In summer you don't want that, so you'd roast.

lines.source: 那開頭那顆包著羽絨衣的冰塊呢？
lines.text: And our wrapped ice cube?

lines.source: 羽絨衣那麼暖，會融得更快吧？
lines.text: It's so warm, it'll melt faster, right?

lines.source: 很多人都會這樣猜。可是它裡面沒有暖爐，
lines.text: Many guess that, but there's no heater inside.

lines.source: 還記得溫度計那一晚嗎？它自己一點也沒變暖。
lines.text: Remember the thermometer night? It didn't warm up at all.

lines.source: 很多學校課堂都會做這個比較：一顆包起來、一顆不包。
lines.text: Lots of classrooms try this: one cube wrapped, one not.

lines.source: 包起來的那顆，融得比較慢。
lines.text: The wrapped one melts slower.

lines.source: 包起來，反而比較慢？！
lines.text: Wrapping makes it slower?!

lines.source: 我知道了！
lines.text: Got it!

lines.source: 穿上會暖，是我的熱被它留住了！
lines.text: It's warm because it keeps MY heat in!

lines.source: 下次你穿上它，等一下下，
lines.text: Wear it, wait a bit:

lines.source: 那一下下，是你的熱正在把裡面填滿。
lines.text: that little wait is your heat filling it up.

lines.source: 原來如此！
lines.text: So that's why!

lines.source: 冰淇淋包在羽絨衣裡，會融得比較快，還是比較慢？
lines.text: Ice cream in a down jacket: melts faster, or slower?

lines.source: 留言告訴我們你的答案。
lines.text: Tell us in the comments.

lines.source: 想一起找生活裡的為什麼，就訂閱原來如此事務所。
lines.text: Want to find life's everyday whys with us? Subscribe to So That's Why.
